subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should `current` and `session:*` cron jobs persist an implicit `{ mode: "announce" }` delivery at creation, or remain persistent session targets whose delivery is resolved at runtime?
rationale: The merged persistent-session contract and current docs distinguish these targets from isolated jobs, while the PR would convert their runtime-derived behavior into stored explicit policy with compatibility and delivery consequences.

options.title: Keep isolated-only initialization
options.body: Preserve the write-time default for detached `isolated` jobs and close or retarget this PR unless a separate runtime delivery defect is reproduced.

options.title: Adopt persistent-target announce
options.body: Approve the policy change only with unified runtime logic, documentation, fresh-install and upgrade tests, and exact-head end-to-end delivery proof.

recommendation.title: Keep isolated-only initialization
recommendation.body: Preserve the write-time default for detached `isolated` jobs and close or retarget this PR unless a separate runtime delivery defect is reproduced.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant persistent-session contract was established by the merged cron restoration connected to this path.
